name: Darshan
description:
Sookshmadarshini 

What does it do?
An AI-powered real-time social media monitoring and compliance platform that detects trends, sentiments, emotions, risks, and influential networks from public data.

Technologies used:
AI/ML, NLP, sentiment & emotion analysis, network analysis, real-time data processing, and a web-based intelligence dashboard.

Why did we create it?
To help authorized government agencies detect emerging threats and harmful narratives early instead of manually monitoring huge volumes of social-media data.

Key features:

Real-time monitoring

Sentiment & 7-emotion analysis

Sarcasm detection

Trend/narrative detection

Network & influence analysis

Privacy-first profiling

Compliance/risk alerts

Actionable intelligence dashboard
